verdict.rationale: Cal.com connects multiple calendars, checks them for conflicts, and writes its own bookings to them. That is adjacent to the story but is not mirroring busy blocks between a work and a personal calendar. No evidence shows automatic cross-calendar busy-block syncing, so this applicable axis gets none.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, busy blocks sync between my work and personal calendars automatically so all my schedules stay in step
